items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bird went up and looked into the coffin, stood there looking at Hot Lips Page.

ctx.x: What about intellectual exchange with Bird?

Yeah, one day I hung out with him the whole day. I happened to run into him on Broadway. He asked me where I was going. I said I was just going down by the union. He said, “Come on with me. I’m going uptown to pay my respects to Lips” – to Hot Lips Page. His body’s up on 145th Street. So I said okay. So we went and got on the subway.
